title: Documented goals mapped to implementation
description: Compare the source documentation in README.md with implementation anchors EDA.py, app.py, clustering_analysis.py. Trace one feature claim to its code path and record any mismatch or evidence gap.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in README.md, EDA.py, app.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for README.md, EDA.py, app.py
completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
